#Review of the organisation of the project

Date: 2026-11-12. Method: static review. Nothing was built or run. No file was changed but this one.

Sources: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/portability.md, docs/testing.md, docs/test-review.md, the import lines of each package of src, src/tools, api, native, tools, .github, and ext/gui_toolkit at tag v0.202.0.

Limits:

  • A count comes from grep or wc on the tree. It is exact for the pattern and approximate for the concept.
  • A cost is an estimate in days of work for one person. No cost was measured.
  • A statement that a procedure runs on the loop thread comes from its callers, not from a run.

The subject is the organisation: boundaries, ownership, duplicated mechanisms, tools, names. Speed of code is not the subject. docs/test-review.md covers the speed and the bounds of the tests: this review does not repeat it.

#Summary

#FindingProposalCost
1The page embedder is built in 5 places. The navigation algorithm exists twice.One package embed: the browser with no shell.10 to 15 days
2src/browser is one package of 235 files. App has about 170 fields. the_app has 1092 uses.Split in 8 packages, leaf packages first.20 to 30 days, in slices
3Files are written in 4 ways. Some writes run on the loop thread.One writer for each profile file. A check build asserts the thread.4 to 6 days
4Preferences are read in 3 ways.Keep the settings struct with one watch for each group.5 to 8 days
5Frames are requested with a count: 317 calls, counts 0 to 4.Request a frame with a cause and a condition.5 to 8 days
6Wren has its own copy of systems that the toolkit has. Wren holds systems that the toolkit must own.Use the toolkit's packages. Move 6 systems.8 to 12 days
7The product imports tools packages. Win32 types are in neutral files.Move 3 packages. Remove 5 imports.2 days
8The web API has two sources. A dead C emitter stays.Finish the move to one source. Delete the other.2 to 3 days
925 programs exist beside wrentool. Versions are pinned in 8 places.One table of programs. One file of pins.3 to 5 days
10The rules of shared memory are not written. The globals lint covers 6 of 40 packages.Write the rules. Extend the lint.3 days

Findings 11 to 14 (the split of src/page, the names, the documents, the dialogs) follow in the text.

#The key prompts

What a principal architect rewrites first. The layer between page and the shell (finding 1). Each program that shows a page builds that layer by hand. The shell and the test tools then run different code for one concept. All other splits depend on this layer.

The single test that breaks the design. Run one table of navigation cases against a tab of the shell and against a headless.Doc. Compare the two event traces. The cases are: a redirect, a download, an error status, a traversal to a cached document, window.open, Cache-Control: no-store. The traces differ, because two implementations exist (src/browser/main.odin:830, src/tools/headless/headless.odin:256). The web-platform-tests run on the second one (src/tools/wpt imports wb:tools/headless). A navigation test that passes there proves nothing about the product.

A second test, for finding 3: in the check build, each file procedure of base asserts that the caller is not the loop thread after the first frame. The test fails at the first save of a notification decision (src/browser/notification_shell.odin:241).

The abstraction that removes a class of problems. An Embedder: a loop, a network client, a blocking pool, a Fetch profile, a loader, the pages, and a Navigation for each top-level window. App contains one. A test contains one. This removes: the harnesses that break when an invariant is added, the navigation written twice, and most uses of the_app in hooks.

The implicit state machines. See the table in "Implicit state machines".

#1. The page embedder is built in 5 places, and navigation exists twice

Value: highest. This is a correctness risk and the cause of the harness failures that docs/test-review.md 5.1 describes.

Evidence. Each of these builds a loop, a network client, a blocking pool, a Fetch profile, a loader and the Wasm imports, in its own order:

PlaceLocation
The shellsrc/browser/main.odin:1726 (app_start, 228 lines), src/browser/process_share.odin:74
The headless tools (WPT, jspage, blockerpages)src/tools/headless/headless.odin:102 (init)
The web testssrc/tools/e2e/web_harness.odin:79 (begin), with the world in package variables at lines 58 to 75
apiconformancesrc/tools/apiconformance/main.odin:35-43
fetch toolsrc/tools/fetch/main.odin:95-99

The navigation of a top-level window exists twice:

  • The shell: document_event (src/browser/main.odin:830), document_loaded (:905), navigate (:514), src/browser/tab_navigation.odin, src/browser/history_restore.odin, src/browser/bfcache.odin.
  • The headless package: document_event (src/tools/headless/headless.odin:256), navigation_start (:237), leave (:302), bfcache_start (:328), bfcache_restore (:341).

Both call page.navigable_keep_window, page.apply_response_headers and page.apply_isolation_headers in the same order. The shell also sets the navigation timing, the preload scan, the download action and no_store. The headless package does not. The two copies will diverge more with each change.

app_make.odin solved this problem for App only. Its comment says why (src/browser/app_make.odin:3-7). The same defect remains one layer below.

Proposal. Add a package src/embed between page and browser:

  • embed.World: the loop, the client, the blocking pool, the profile, the loader, the storage manager, the page.Pages, the process scope. One world_make(Options) and one world_free. Stages are not necessary: a program sets Options (profile directory, preferences, in-memory cache).
  • embed.Navigation: the state of one top-level window. It holds the session history, the document in flight, the back/forward cache and the phase (Nav_Phase of src/browser/tab_navigation.odin:23). It reports events to its owner through a small table of procedures: adopted, failed, download, title, status.
  • Tab contains an embed.Navigation. headless.Doc becomes a thin wrapper, then is removed.
  • process_share.odin moves to embed: it has no dependency on the interface.

browser.App contains an embed.World. web_harness.odin, apiconformance and fetch call world_make.

Extend src/tools/test_all/lint_app_make.odin: no host.loop_init, fetch.loader_init or page.register_imports outside src/embed and the unit tests of those packages.

Cost: 10 to 15 days. Do it in three steps that each keep a working product: World first (3 days), then Navigation with the shell as its only user (5 to 8 days), then the headless package on top of it (3 days).

#2. src/browser is one package that holds 8 subsystems

Evidence:

  • 235 files that are not tests, 78 test files, 85 826 lines in total.
  • App (src/browser/main.odin:147-311) has about 170 fields. 60 of them are the state of one subsystem, each with a comment that names the owner file.
  • the_app has 1092 uses in 88 files. The top files are newtab_art.odin (107), devtools_net_detail.odin (70) and devtools_kit.odin (65). docs/architecture.md says that the_app is "what is left". It is the main access path for the developer tools and the painter.
  • main.odin has 2145 lines. It holds the tab life cycle, the navigation, the document load, the page input (route_page_input, line 1220), the profile save, the preferences, the frame (frame, line 1498, 180 lines) and the start.
  • The file names already show the units: 25 devtools_* files, 10 tab_*, 8 remote_*, 8 blocker_*, 8 about_*, 4 cdp_*, 4 paint_*, 27 *_shell files.
  • The classes of tools/globals_allowed.txt show one unit clearly. 12 of the 16 thread globals of browser belong to "the thread that paints" (compositor.odin, paint_planes.odin, paint_masks.odin, shaders.odin, forms_plane.odin, canvas_shell.odin).

One package means no boundary. Any file can read and write any field of App. A test of the bookmarks store must link the renderer.

Proposal. Split by ownership of state. Each new package has its own state struct and takes what it needs as parameters. No new package takes ^App.

PackageContentDepends on
profileThe stores of a profile with no interface: profile_writes, session, global_history, bookmarks, closed_tabs, search_engines, the model of download, crash_recovery, update_check, the decisions of notification_shellhost, base, fetch
embedFinding 1: the world, the navigation, tab_navigation, history_restore, bfcache, process_sharepage, fetch, net
paintThe page painter and the compositor: render, compositor, paint_*, effects_cache, text_decoration, shaders, canvas_gpu, canvas_shell, images_shell, video_shell, video_fast_path, fonts, web_font_faces, gpu_steps, forms_planelayout, page, the toolkit
pageviewOne page in one window: page_input, page_frame, page_cursor, page_autoscroll, pointer_gesture, smooth_scroll, selection_shell, touch_shell, frames_shell, first_paint, shell_shown, shell_framespaint, embed
inspectorThe developer tools: the 25 devtools_* files, console_evalpageview, embed
controlAutomation: remote_methods, remote_shell, remote_state, remote_timeline, remote_extras, control, control_window, the 4 cdp_* filesembed, remote
viewsThe about: pages: config_ui, settings_page, history_ui, history_tree, downloads_ui, bookmarks_ui, blocker_dashboard, blocker_ui, blocker_picker, http_cache_ui, site_data_ui, search_engines_ui, about_*, newtab_art*, demos, error_pages, ext_pageprofile, the toolkit
browserThe composition root: main, app_make, windows, chrome, the tab strip and sidebar, urlbar, status_bar, commands, palette, context_menu, the prompts, settingsall of the above

The name inspector avoids a conflict with the toolkit's package devtools (ext/gui_toolkit/src/devtools/devtools.odin:14).

Order. Odin has no cyclic imports, so a unit can leave only when it does not read App.

  1. profile first: its files take ^App mostly for profile_dir, cfg.persist_profile, the blocking pool and the toast. Give them a profile.Store with those four things. 4 to 5 days.
  2. paint second: it already keeps its state apart (thread globals, App.page_render, the settings structs at main.odin:262-270). 5 to 7 days.
  3. control and inspector after finding 1, because both read tabs and navigations. 4 to 6 days each.
  4. views and pageview last.

Cost: 20 to 30 days in total. Each step is a move of files with a change of signatures. Each step keeps the product working. Do not start a step before finding 1, step 1.

A rule to add to docs/architecture.md: a new subsystem of the shell is a new package with its own state. It is not a new group of fields of App.

#3. Files are written in 4 ways, and some writes run on the loop thread

AGENTS.md says that no disk call runs on the interface thread, "not even a stat".

Evidence. The four ways:

  1. Profile_File (src/browser/profile_writes.odin:1-13): the blocking pool, one write at a time, an atomic replace, a retry with a growing delay, one report to the user, a flush at exit. This is the complete design. Only the preferences file, the session files and the extensions' files use it (src/browser/ext_shell.odin:119).
  2. A job written by hand on the blocking pool with base.file_write_atomic: the history (src/browser/global_history.odin:356, with its own retry at :440-443), the bookmark export (src/browser/bookmarks_ui.odin:473), the Vault (src/vault/vault.odin:1021, not atomic).
  3. base.file_write_atomic called directly: src/browser/cdp_targets.odin:166, src/cookies/jar.odin:417, src/fetch/hsts.odin:157, src/page/storage.odin:271.
  4. os.write_entire_file, which is not atomic: 43 calls outside tests and tools.

Writes of the fourth kind that run on the loop thread, by their callers:

LocationFile written
src/browser/update_check.odin:101 (called at :134, :159)The state of the update check
src/browser/setup.odin:107 (called at :136, :146, :151)The answer of the Setup dialog
src/browser/notification_shell.odin:241 (called at :95)The notification decisions
src/page/service_worker.odin:236 and :245 (8 callers, for example :556, :850)The registrations, and each worker script
src/page/storage_buckets.odin:66 and :69The storage buckets
src/browser/license_shell.odin:112A marker file

A crash during one of these writes leaves a file cut short. The service worker registry is the largest risk: the file is rewritten at each state change of a registration.

Reads have the same defect in smaller number, for example os.exists at src/browser/download.odin:499 and a directory read at src/browser/newtab_art.odin:1053.

Proposal:

  • Keep way 1. Move Profile_File to the profile package of finding 2, then to the toolkit (finding 6): the toolkit's store package has the same design with a Writer for a file that the program formats (ext/gui_toolkit/src/store/store.odin:1-12).
  • Each file of the profile has one Profile_File and one owner. The six writes of the table use it.
  • page receives the writer from its embedder (Storage_Manager already takes the loop and the blocking pool).
  • Diagnostic outputs (prof.odin, memcheck_report_*, remote_timeline.odin) can stay as direct writes: a developer asks for them. Mark each with one named procedure, diag_write, so that the lint below can see the difference.
  • Add a lint to test_all: no os.write_entire_file, os.rename or os.remove in src outside base, the writer, and diag_write.
  • Add the assertion of "The key prompts" to the check build.

Cost: 4 to 6 days. The lint and the assertion take 1 day and find the complete list.

#4. Preferences are read in 3 ways

Evidence:

  1. A settings struct made by settings_from_prefs. 65 such procedures exist, 23 of them in src/browser. apply_prefs (src/browser/main.odin:1397-1421) rebuilds the structs of fetch, cookies, page and the shell at each change of any preference, through one watch on the empty prefix (:1851). It then restyles every tab (:1410) and requests 3 frames.
  2. A watch on a prefix that rebuilds one struct: 30 config.watch calls in src/browser, with the watch ids in four different places of App (watches, font_watch, text_watch, look_watch, main.odin:204, :278-279).
  3. A read by name at the point of use: about 131 of the 426 by-name reads of src/browser are outside a settings procedure. Examples: src/browser/commands.odin:135, :618-620, src/browser/cdp.odin:96-102, src/browser/closed_tabs.odin:137.

A fourth mechanism routes a change: pref_groups_of (src/browser/prefs_apply.odin:18-27) maps a name to one of 4 groups by its prefix. The 30 watches do the same work with other prefixes.

Drift from the documents: docs/architecture.md:31-33 and AGENTS.md say that a preference is declared in the package's settings.odin. 52 files of src/browser declare a config.Def table outside settings.odin.

Each by-name read is a string that the compiler does not check. A renamed preference fails at run time, and config.ref_of runs a map lookup at each read.

Proposal. Keep way 2 as the only way, with one form:

  • One declaration for each group: the Def table, the struct, the reader and the prefix. For example config.group(&prefs, "browser.urlbar.", URLBAR_DEFS, &app.ub.cfg, urlbar_settings_read, on_change).
  • The registry keeps the watch. The owner keeps only the struct. The four places of watch ids in App go away.
  • apply_prefs, pref_groups_of and the watch on the empty prefix are removed. Each group reads its own prefix.
  • A read by name stays legal in two places: the generic views (config_ui.odin, the settings page) and a command that toggles one preference.
  • Add a lint: no config.*_of( outside a file that declares the Def of that name.
  • Decide where a table lives, then say it in one document: in the file of its subsystem, as the code does now. Correct docs/architecture.md and AGENTS.md.

config.group belongs to the toolkit's config package: each program of the toolkit has this need.

Cost: 5 to 8 days. Most of it is mechanical. The removal of apply_prefs needs care: it also arms the autosave and sets the timer slice.

#5. Frames are requested with a count

Evidence. request_frames(app, n) (src/browser/windows.odin:233) has 317 calls: 172 with n = 2, 73 with 3, 10 with 1, 9 with 4, 1 with 0. The count says "the result needs n frames to settle". The caller cannot know that number. The comment at src/browser/main.odin:1548-1549 records one failure of this design: two frames every half second, for ever.

A second, better mechanism exists beside it: Frame_Causes (main.odin:1557-1564) and Frame_Errand (src/browser/windows.odin:217). They say why a frame is made.

The target of a request is also implicit. request_frames chooses the active window, or the window of the page whose task runs (windows.odin:234-242, with App.tasks_running and App.task_own).

docs/test-review.md 1.1 asks for an at_rest condition. That condition cannot be computed while pending work is a count.

Proposal:

  • invalidate(window, cause): one frame, with a cause. Used by a change that one frame shows.
  • animate(window, key, until): frames while a condition holds. The condition is a procedure or a deadline of the loop's clock. Used by what settles over time.
  • A callback names its window. The inference from App.tasks_running goes away.
  • at_rest is then: no invalidation, no animation, no timer that draws.

Remove request_frames when the last caller is moved. Do not keep both.

Cost: 5 to 8 days. Start with the 73 calls that ask for 3 frames: each one hides a settle condition.

#6. The toolkit: copies to remove, and systems to move

AGENTS.md says: a system that more than one program will use moves to gui_toolkit.

Wren has its own copy of what the toolkit has:

WrenToolkitNote
src/tools/wrentool/changelog (862 lines, plus 320 of tests)src/changelog (tk_changelog, 477 lines)The same fragment format, word for word in the header comments.
src/tools/wrentool/release (package, notes)src/release (tk_release: package, notes, ship)
src/tools/test_all/lint_globals.odin, lint_unicode_case.odin, with tools/globals_allowed.txttests/globals, with tools/globals_allowed.txt and tools/unicode_case_allowed.txtTwo implementations of one lint.
The scheduler of src/tools/test_all (643 lines), its desktop of its owntools/run_tests (429 lines), with the same desktop_* files
extract_flag, extract_switch (src/browser/main.odin:1683-1697)src/cli--help and the refusal of an unknown option come free.
The CDP server of src/browser/cdp*.odinsrc/devtools (a CDP server), src/cdp (a client)Verify what the two servers can share: the handshake, the /json endpoints, the loopback guard.

Wren holds systems that another program of the toolkit needs:

SystemLocationWhy it is generic
The event loop with timers, scopes of work, the blocking pool, the dialog threads, named threads, the thread poolsrc/host (2411 lines)No web concept. AGENTS.md forbids blocking work on the interface thread in each program: each program needs this pool.
Scopes and generational handlessrc/base/scope.odin, the pool and handle files of src/baseRule 1 and rule 2 of docs/architecture.md are not about the web.
The profile file writersrc/browser/profile_writes.odinMerge it with tk_store.Writer: one has the retry and the report, the other has the debounce.
Crash reports and stackssrc/tools/crashtrace (1289 lines), src/tools/stacksThe product links both. Any program of the toolkit can crash.
The test scheduler with its cache and its lintssrc/tools/test_allSee the table above.
The poison allocator and the trackersrc/base/poison.odinThe toolkit has arena and testkit already.

A name conflict blocks the first row. The toolkit has packages named host and base (ext/gui_toolkit/src/host/host.odin:31, src/base/perf.odin:3), and Wren has wb:host and wb:base. The comment of src/config/config.odin says that a package name is unique in a build. Rename the toolkit's window host first, for example to tk_window_host, then move Wren's loop under a name that says what it is, for example tk_loop.

Alias packages: src/config (81 lines), src/i18n (16), src/update (23) and src/tools/tooling re-export a toolkit package. They exist so that callers keep wb: imports. src/browser imports the toolkit with the toolkit: collection, and src/base imports it with a relative path (../../ext/gui_toolkit/src/arena). Use one way: the toolkit: collection in each package, and remove the alias packages. AGENTS.md asks for no compatibility layer.

Cost: 2 days for the changelog and release copies. 1 day for the alias packages. 3 to 4 days for host with the rename. 2 days for crash reports. 3 to 5 days for the test scheduler. Each move needs a toolkit tag before Wren points to it.

#7. Layering violations

The import graph has no cycle. Odin refuses one. The violations are imports in the wrong direction of meaning.

ViolationEvidenceProposal

core:sys/windows in neutral filesmain.odin:13, windows.odin:29, prof.odin:28, devtools_window.odin:14, instance_shell.odin:33; 19 uses of ODIN_OS in 13 files of src/browserMove each use to a file with a system suffix, as AGENTS.md asks.
A URL package depends on the script enginesrc/url imports wb:engine/regexp and wb:engine/unicode for URLPattern (5 pattern*.odin files)Move URLPattern to src/urlpattern. cookies, csp and webauthn then do not link the regular expression engine.
The engine depends on the registrysrc/engine/frontend, regexp, unicode import wb:configAcceptable: a Def table is data. No change.
Two packages with one namesrc/e2e is package e2e; src/tools/e2e is package e2e_scenariosRename the folder src/tools/e2e to src/tools/e2e_scenarios.

Cost: 2 days for all rows.

#8. Generated code and its sources

Evidence:

  • The web API has two sources. api/ holds 78 .widl files and 77 .odin files (6972 lines). The header of each .odin file says: "The Odin form is the source of truth once the .widl is removed" (api/abort.odin:1). bindgen reads the .widl files (src/tools/bindgen/main.odin:66, :128). AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md say that a new API starts in a .widl file. A change made in the .odin file has no effect.
  • A dead emitter stays. bindgen -emit:c writes native/js/gen/bindings.c and wren_api.h (src/tools/bindgen/main.odin:39, :70, :321-322). The comment says "no longer used". The folder native/js/gen does not exist.
  • The names of generated files have five forms: api_generated.odin, bindings_gen.odin, cexport_gen.odin, atoms_table.odin, opcodes.odin. A lint cannot find them by name.
  • Two generated files name no generator that exists in the tree. src/engine/jscapi/cexport_gen.odin:3 says "by a script". src/engine/jsrt/atoms_table.odin:3 and opcodes.odin:3 name QuickJS headers.
  • Generators are in three places: src/tools/bindgen, src/tools/wrentool/gen, and src/engine/unicode/gen, a program inside the engine's tree.
  • src/page/api_generated.odin has 45 233 lines: 43 % of the package page.
  • Generated output is committed in four trees: sdk/ (61 files), docs/api/ (62 files), site/ (600 files, 17 MB), native/js/odin/bindings_gen.odin (32 803 lines). test_all checks that each is up to date. This is a choice, and it is consistent.
  • native/ holds the Rust workspace and, in native/js/odin, the Odin glue of the script engine. docs/architecture.md calls native/ "the Rust library". The glue is Odin compiled to Wasm: it is not native.

Proposal:

  • Finish the move in one commit: point bindgen at api/*.odin, run -verify-roundtrip once, delete the .widl files, the converter and the round-trip check. Or delete the 77 .odin files. Do not keep both. The .odin form removes a parser (src/tools/bindgen/webidl stays for webref), so the first option is preferable.
  • Delete -emit:c and emit_c.odin.
  • One suffix: *_generated.odin. One first line: // Code generated by <tool> from <source>. DO NOT EDIT. Add a lint in test_all: a file with that line has that suffix, and its generator exists.
  • Write the generators of cexport_gen.odin, atoms_table.odin and opcodes.odin as wrentool gen commands, or declare the three files as written by hand.
  • Move src/engine/unicode/gen to src/tools/wrentool/gen.
  • Keep api_generated.odin in page. A package of its own is not possible: the generated types hold pointers to the types of page (Api_AbortController.data: ^Abort_Controller, src/page/api_generated.odin:22-25) and the trampolines call the lookup_* procedures of page. The import would be cyclic.
  • Move native/js/odin to src/engine/glue. native/ is then only Rust.

Cost: 2 to 3 days. The move of the glue is 1 day more, mostly paths in the builder.

#9. Tooling

Evidence:

  • CONTRIBUTING.md:113 says: "Everything the project runs besides the compiler is one Odin program". 25 programs with a main exist in src/tools beside wrentool: test_all, bindgen, buildjs, jsengine, test262, wpt, e2e, apiconformance, docsite, license, endurance, crashmodes, blockerpages, adblockbench, mediabench, mediaplay, wasmbench, cssaudit, fetch, runwasm, jspage, wrencom, and others.
  • wrentool starts some of them by a path in a string: tool_run("src/tools/license", ...) (src/tools/wrentool/gen/gen.odin:311), tool_run("src/tools/docsite", ...) (:327). test_all has its own list in steps.odin and tasks.odin. Two lists of how to build each program exist.
  • The package gen mixes concerns: code generation, the documentation site, the licence tool, the translation check, the portability check, test262, a trace recording and a desktop (gen.odin:24, :311, :314, :411, :471, :529, :578).
  • Flags have two forms: -Urls, -List, -Exe in wrentool and test_all (src/tools/wrentool/capture/sweep.odin:86-96), and --profile, --policy in wren (src/browser/main.odin:1741-1745).
  • test_all is started with a long command (odin run src/tools/test_all -collection:wb=src -out:build/test_all -keep-executable). It imports wb:tools/wrentool/builder.
  • Versions are pinned in many places. Odin: 4 workflow files, flake.nix:52, odin.version, README.md:256, CONTRIBUTING.md:76. Rust 1.99.1: 3 workflow files and 4 cache keys. Wasmtime 49.0.3: src/tools/wrentool/deps/fetch.odin:9, flake.nix:81, two documents.
  • The workflows hold about 120 lines of inline PowerShell and shell. The download of Odin with its digest is written three times (.github/actions/setup/action.yml:20-37, setup-linux/action.yml:11, linux-package.yml:65, pages.yml:41).
  • The folder tools/ holds allow lists and the Go test server. The folder src/tools/ holds the programs. The folder src/testserver holds the Odin binding of the Go server.

Not a defect: the Go test server and the TypeScript worker of licence/worker are programs, not automation scripts. No shell, PowerShell, Python or Node script exists in the tree beside build.sh and build.bat, and both are shortcuts as AGENTS.md asks.

Proposal:

  • One table of programs in src/tools/tooling: name, folder, output, flags, sources. wrentool, test_all and the builder read it. wrentool run <program> [arguments] builds a program if its sources are newer, then runs it.
  • wrentool test [flags] is the entry of test_all. The long command leaves the documents.
  • Split gen: gen keeps generation. check takes i18n, portability, docs -Check, changelog -Check. run_license, run_engine and run_desktop become rows of the table of programs.
  • One file of pins at the root, versions.txt (odin, rust, wasmtime, wgpu, nasm, go). wrentool fetch and flake.nix read it (builtins.readFile). A workflow reads it with one step. wrentool check fails when a document names another version.
  • wrentool ci setup holds what the inline scripts do after the download of Odin. Only that download stays in YAML, once, in a composite action that the four files use.
  • One flag form for new commands: --name, with the toolkit's cli package. Move the old flags when a command is touched. Accept both forms during the move only inside tooling.flag.
  • Rename the root folder tools/ to lists/, and move the Go server to testserver/. The word "tools" then has one meaning.

Cost: 3 to 5 days.

#10. Shared state and ownership rules

What is good: docs/architecture.md "Where state lives" is clear. tools/globals_allowed.txt and its lint hold it. process_share.odin documents its state machine. app_make.odin has stages and one destructor.

Gaps:

  • The temporary allocator has no written rule. src/browser has 1242 uses of context.temp_allocator and 894 of fmt.tprintf. src/page has 955 and 251. The memory lives until free_all at the end of frame (src/browser/main.odin:1679, and the early returns at :1545, :1567). A nested frame protects the outer one with a mark (src/browser/shell_frames.odin:427-428). Worker threads free after each job (src/host/blocking.odin:116). No document states the rule. 90 procedures of browser and page take allocator := context.temp_allocator and return memory. A caller that keeps such a result past the frame reads freed memory. The check build poisons it, so the defect shows only on a path that a test runs.
  • The globals lint covers 6 packages: browser, page, style, layout, media, js (src/tools/test_all/lint_globals.odin:28). A rough count finds package variables outside: wasm about 29, base 14, host 6, remote 6, images 6, idb 5, canvas2d 4.
  • Thread-local variables carry parameters. headless_software (src/browser/main.odin:1724) and headless_no_pixels (src/browser/headless_pixels.odin:11) are set before app_start and read by it.
  • The active window is an ambient parameter. active_window(app) returns App.active, or App.bare (main.odin:219-222). window_activate exchanges a part of the window (Window_Ctx), and Window_Own is "not exchanged" (src/browser/windows.odin:61, :73). A procedure that takes ^App acts on a window that its signature does not show.
  • the_pages has 567 uses in src/page (src/page/pages.odin:67). It is the App's state reached through the thread. It is documented. It is also the reason why a page cannot move to another thread without page.bind.

Proposal:

  • Add a section "Temporary memory" to docs/architecture.md, with four rules. A result in temporary memory lives until the caller returns to the loop. A value kept in a struct is cloned. A thread frees its temporary memory at the end of each job. A nested loop turn takes a mark.
  • Name the two end points: base.temp_end_of_turn() and base.temp_scope(). A search then finds each place.
  • Extend GLOBALS_DIRS to each package of src outside tools and engine. Class each global that the lint finds. Cost: 1 day, mostly for wasm.
  • app_start(args, Start_Options{software, pixels}) replaces the two thread-local parameters.
  • Procedures of the chrome take ^Browser_Window. active_window stays only at the entry of a frame and of a command. This comes with finding 2.

Cost: 3 days without the window parameter.

#11. src/page mixes six concerns

Evidence: 183 files that are not tests, 106 250 lines with the generated file. By prefix: 42 js_* files (the realm, script loading, the DOM bindings for scripts), 28 bindings_* files (the implementations of the generated trampolines), service workers and workers, storage (Cache API, file system, buckets, Web Storage), media, frames and navigables, and images. page imports 24 packages of src.

page.Pages (src/page/pages.odin) is to page what App is to browser: one struct that each file reaches through the_pages.

Proposal, in order of ease:

  1. storage: storage.odin, storage_buckets.odin, cache_store.odin, fs_store.odin, fs_api.odin. They are stores of a profile with files (finding 3). They need an origin and a directory, not a page.
  2. workers: service_worker.odin, worker.odin, shared_workers, ports. They have their own Wasm store (rule 3 of docs/architecture.md).
  3. scripting: js_realm.odin, js_load*.odin. The script loader is a state machine of HTML with six enums (src/page/js_load.odin:42-64): it deserves a boundary and its own tests.

Do not split the bindings_* files: they are the surface of page by design.

Cost: 3 days for storage. 5 days each for the two others. Value is lower than findings 1 to 5: do it when a change touches the area.

#12. Dialogs and prompts

System dialogs have one mechanism, and it is correct: host.run_dialog runs the blocking call on its own thread and answers on the loop (src/host/dialog.odin:41). 8 call sites of src/browser use it. One exception: license_choose_file (src/browser/license_shell.odin:208-221) calls platform.open_file_dialog through host.run_blocking. The loop is not blocked, but a worker of the blocking pool waits while a person answers. The comment of App.dialogs forbids this (src/browser/main.odin:163). Move it to host.run_dialog.

The repetition is above it. Each call site declares its job struct, its work, its done and its discard (blocker_files.odin:34, bookmarks_ui.odin:448, context_menu.odin:527, download.odin:380, :719, ext_page.odin:245, forms_shell.odin:1763, fs_shell.odin:77). Proposal: one procedure, pick(app, kind, options, done, user), that owns the job and the result. The call sites keep only done.

Permission prompts of a page exist three times, each with its own queue, modal and store: fs_shell.odin:133 (App.ask_state), notification_shell.odin:189 (App.notes), storage_access_shell.odin:43 (App.sa_queue). A fourth form exists for confirmations (confirm_shell.odin). Proposal: one Permission_Prompt queue for each window, with a kind, an origin, a text and an answer callback, and one store of decisions by origin and kind. A new permission (geolocation, camera) is then one enum value.

Cost: 1 day for pick. 3 days for the prompts.

A machine is implicit when its state is a set of booleans, a count, or the position in a procedure.

#What is in good order

These parts need no change of organisation:

  • The dependency graph below page has clear layers and no cycle. net does not know fetch. fetch does not know page.
  • The split of mechanism and policy between net and fetch holds in the imports.
  • One description generates the host side, the SDK, the documents and the conformance tests.
  • app_make.odin with its lint.
  • The changelog fragments, the opt-in classes of tests, the lint of sleeps.
  • build.sh and build.bat are shortcuts with no logic.
  • flake.nix exposes checks with the pre-commit hooks through pkgs.prek.
  • System dialogs never block the loop.

#Order of work

  1. The lints that find the complete lists, with no change of code: file writes (3), by-name preference reads (4), imports against tools/layers.txt (14), all packages in the globals lint (10). 3 days. Each later step then has a number that goes down.
  2. Finish the API source move and delete the C emitter (8). 2 days.
  3. The cheap layering fixes and the licence spelling (7, 13). 3 days.
  4. embed.World, then embed.Navigation (1). 10 to 15 days.
  5. One writer for profile files, with the profile package (3, and step 1 of 2). 6 to 8 days.
  6. Preferences by group (4). 5 to 8 days.
  7. Toolkit: use tk_changelog and tk_release; move the loop, the writer, crash reports (6). 8 to 12 days.
  8. Frames by cause (5). 5 to 8 days.
  9. The remaining packages of the split of src/browser (2). 15 to 20 days.
  10. Tooling: the table of programs, the file of pins (9). 3 to 5 days.
  11. src/page (11) and prompts (12), when a change touches them.
